dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Sahmi nidaamka tolida, midabada dunta, boodboodka, goynta, iyo amarka mashiinka ka hor wax soo saar. Horudhac u samee naqshadda tol tol, beddel qaababka render-ka, oo dhoofso waxa aad aragto.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Jilitaanka daabacaadda, baaritaanka, iyo dhoofinta isdhexgalka ah.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Haysa xisaabta (ruler) ee shaashadda oo jiid slider-ka ilaa uu baarka hoose uu noqdo dhererkiisu 100 mm, ka dib riix OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Koobiyee sawirka buuxa ee tayada sare leh ee clipboard-ka

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Luuqadda waxaa lagu beddelay {language}. Dib u bilow InkSim hadda si ay u dhaqangasho?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Waxaa la isticmaali doonaa luuqadda asalka ah ee nidaamka. Dib u bilow InkSim hadda si ay u dhaqangasho?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Daaqadaha InkSim ee furan oo dhan waa la xidhi doonaa, faylka hadda jirana dib ayaa loo furi doonaa.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_failed.translation: Dhoofinta CSV ee Ink/Stitch way fashilantay.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Waqtigii loo qabtay horudhaca tolmada wuu dhammaaday.

dialog.open_browser.converting.translation: Dhoofinta CSV ee Ink/Stitch ayaa socota...

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: SVG-gan ku fur daaqad cusub oo Inkscape ah.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Galkan kuma jiraan faylal la taageero.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Laba jeer guji galka si aad u baadho faylashiisa.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Laba jeer guji galka si aad u baadho faylashiisa.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo tafatiro faylasha SVG.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Waxaa loo baahan yahay rakibaad Ink/Stitch ah oo la habeeyey iyo barnaamij-bilaabiye Python.

dialog.open_browser.not_embroidery.translation: Ma aha fayl tolmo oo sax ah

dialog.open_browser.open_hint.translation: Fur faylka tolmada ee la doortay.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Ka soo saar xogta tolmada SVG-kan adigoo adeegsanaya Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Lama wadi karo qoraalka Ink/Stitch ee firfircoon ama barnaamijka Python ee loo habeeyey.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Kordhinta Ink/Stitch: lama hubin karin. Isticmaal Qalab... si aad mar kale isugu daydo.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Kordhinta Ink/Stitch: lagama helin galalka kordhinta ee Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Kordhinta Ink/Stitch: lama hubin karo ilaa Inkscape la habeeyo.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Kordhinta Ink/Stitch: weli lama hubin. Isticmaal Qalab... si aad u hubiso.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Faylka asalka ah ee SVG. Horudhaca tolmada wuxuu u baahan yahay Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Faylka asalka ah ee SVG. Dooro Horudhac si aad xogta tolmada ugu samayso Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: SVG-gani aad buu u weyn yahay si halkan horudhac looga sameeyo.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Fayl ku-meelgaar ah oo horudhac ah lama samayn karin: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Nooca faylkan lagama furi karo InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Xaaladda kordhinta Inkscape lama kaydin karin: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Galalka kordhinta Inkscape lama baari karin: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_user_current.translation: Kordhinta isticmaalaha ee hadda (meesha rakibidda/cusboonaysiinta): {path} | Xaaladda: {status}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Kordhinnada Inkscape ee InkSim lama rakibi karin: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Kordhinnada Inkscape ee InkSim waa lagu rakibay ama lagu cusboonaysiiyey {path}. Dib u bilow Inkscape si loo raro.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Galalka kordhinta Inkscape lama akhrin karin: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Dib u bilow Inkscape si loo adeegsado fasiraha cusub ee Python.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Ka saar nuqulladii hore ee InkSim

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Galkii hore ee kordhinta InkSim lama saari karin: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Galalkii hore ee kordhinta InkSim waa la saaray. Dib u bilow Inkscape si liiska kordhintiisa loo cusboonaysiiyo.

integration.inkscape.report.active_inkst.translation: Rakibidda Ink/Stitch ee firfircoon waa la cusboonaysiiyey: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Habaynta la helay waxaa lagu kaydiyey qaabaynta InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.executable.translation: Faylka la fulin karo ee Inkscape waa la hubiyey: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Lama baari karin galalka kordhinta Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.inkstitch_no.translation: Wax rakibid Ink/Stitch ah lama helin.

integration.inkscape.report.interpreter_.translation: Fasiraha Python hore ayaa loo habeeyey: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Barnaamijka bilaabaha ee loo baahan yahay '{command}' lama helin; doorbidka sidii hore ayaa loo daayey.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape lama helin. Dooro faylkiisa la fulin karo si aad u baadho habaynta.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Fasiraha Python lama hubin ama lama cusboonaysiin karin: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Doorbidka fasiraha Python lama hubin sababtoo ah galka kordhinta isticmaalaha lama heli karo.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Dib u bilow Inkscape si fasiraha la cusboonaysiiyey loo adeegsado.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Dooro faylka Inkscape ee la fulin karo si aad u baadho.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape kama jawaabin {seconds} ilbiriqsi gudahood. Waxaa laga yaabaa in xiriirka ay xannibayaan tusaale kale oo Inkscape ah ama kordhin. Xir tusaalooyinka kale ee Inkscape ama demi kordhinta xannibaysa, ka dibna mar kale isku day.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Barnaamijka bilaabaha ee loo baahan yahay '{command}' lama helin. Adigu ku rakib qalabka uvr adigoo adeegsanaya `uv tool install uvr`, ka dibna mar kale socodsii qaabayntan. InkSim kuu rakibi maayo.

integration.inkstitch.not_found.translation: Wax rakibid Ink/Stitch ah lama helin.

menu.file.quit_all.translation: Ka bax daaqadaha oo dhan iyo server-ka

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Ma jiro fayl daabacad oo la soo shubay si loo dhoofiyo.

message.no_file_to_save.translation: Ma jiro fayl daabacad oo la soo shubay.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Dib u dhig ballaca khadka iyo qodobada hadhka

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Guji si aad u hagaajiso qodobka mugdiga, qodobka iftiinka iyo ballaca khadka

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Muuqaalka hoose (ku sawir tolmo dambe oo hoos yimaada kuwa hore)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Wareeji muujinta boodboodka: dami, dhammaan, khatarta kaliya
